title: Qwen3.6-27B final sole-T16 prefill residual exhaustion audit

retained_production.correctness: Complete retained category and llama-compatible safeguards pass; decode and MTP use exact small-row owners; tracked peaks are unchanged and close returns zero.

final_residual_screen.decision: Remove runtime ownership because the mandatory canonical W7900 M512 non-regression gate fails. Retain only the diagnostic leaf and exact production owner.

attempted_lanes_reconciled: Source-shaped dense Q4/Q5 integer MMQ and raw-Q sidecar routes lose or violate sole-layout residency.

Exact dual-Q4 gate/up+SiLU, unequal Q4 QKV/gate, direct Q6 record producer, selective Q4 pair producer, Q5 octet producer, full-attention-Q pair producer, and mixed Q6/Q4 pair-only gate routes are retained defaults.
Direct BF16 rocBLAS output and source-F16 ping-pong pipeline were measured regressions.
Full-attention Q4 source-F16 is bounded below M2048 because large rows lose; singleton Q4 gates were rejected until the retained mixed-pair-only boundary made only 24 layers positive.
The final remaining exact Q4/Q4 operation passes quality and XTX but fails W7900 complete-wall non-regression.

GDN, FlashAttention, casts/fills/copies, dense F32 projections, KV format, and launch-count-only work lack a new reconciled byte-neutral operation boundary large enough to justify reopening prefill parity.

scope_result.objective_status: exhausted under current no-regression, sole-T16, byte-neutral constraints

reopen_rules: A materially new operation-complete sole-resident Q4 dataflow that differs from the rejected source-F16 Q4/Q4 operation.
A producer-consumer fusion that removes enough rocBLAS/output-cast launch or memory traffic to pass both gfx1100 boards, not another tile-only sweep.
A compiler, rocBLAS, driver, hardware, or llama.cpp baseline change that invalidates current cross-board economics.
A fresh reconciled retained-path profile proving a different byte-neutral family has enough complete-wall ceiling and a matched comparator deficit.
do_not_reopen_without_new_mechanism: raw Q4/Q5 sidecars or canonical-format pools
source-shaped Q4/Q5 integer MMQ variants already screened
the Q4/Q4 unequal source-F16 operation recorded in the final rejection artifact
small FP16 tile, direct-BF16 output, ping-pong, attention-only, KV, GDN, or launch-count-only prefill work
decision: Close the residual prefill lane. Keep the retained pair-only package and public matrix unchanged; report raw HIP parity as achieved, HIP+1% as achieved at 1K/4K and blocked by 0.928% at 512, with no decode/memory/MTP regression.
